dedupe_keys.name: eratv european register of authorised types of railway vehicles

description: ERATV is the European register of types of railway vehicles authorised by the European Union Agency for Railways or by Member States. The register page says it was established under Directive 2008/57/EC on the interoperability of the rail system and Commission Implementing Decision 2011/665/EU, as amended by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/776, and links to the consolidated decision and an application guide; questions go to the ERA service desk. Coverage: vehicle types authorised in the EU. Format and access: an online register. Licence and cost: free to consult; no reuse licence is stated on the page. Caveats: the page describes the legal basis, not the fields, and it records types, not individual vehicles. It supports capacity planning and fleet studies that need the technical characteristics of authorised rolling stock. It relates to the ERA register of infrastructure (RINF) and the ERA railway system data inventory in the catalogue.
